DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Get colony summary
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Read a compact storyteller-safe summary and narrative pressure assessment of the current incident target.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Get recent letters
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Read recent letters from the game archive, falling back to the visible LetterStack.

li.name: count
li.description: Maximum number of recent letters to return. Range 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: List map pawns
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: List spawned pawns on the current map and return pawnId values for follow-up detail queries.

li.name: filter
li.description: Optional pawn filter. Defaults to all.

li.name: count
li.description: Maximum number of pawns to return. Range 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Get pawn details
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Read detailed information about one spawned pawn by pawnId or name.

li.name: pawnId
li.description: Pawn id returned by list_map_pawns. A pawn name or ThingID may also work as fallback.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: List available incidents
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: List cached incidents that target the current map/world and can fire now.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Can fire incident
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Validate one cached incident def against the current target and storyteller settings.

li.name: incidentDef
li.description: RimWorld IncidentDef defName from list_available_incidents.

li.name: pointsFactor
li.description: Threat point multiplier. Defaults to 1.0.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Propose incident
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Create a structured incident proposal without executing it.

li.name: incidentDef
li.description: RimWorld IncidentDef defName from list_available_incidents.

li.name: pointsFactor
li.description: Threat point multiplier. Keep near 1.0 unless the story strongly justifies it.

li.name: reason
li.description: Short reason for the chosen story beat.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Schedule incident
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Validate and schedule the final incident choice. Use this when ready.

li.name: incidentDef
li.description: RimWorld IncidentDef defName from list_available_incidents.

li.name: pointsFactor
li.description: Threat point multiplier. Keep near 1.0 unless the story strongly justifies it.

li.name: reason
li.description: Short reason for the chosen story beat.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Trigger raid
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Validate a precise enemy raid request with optional faction, raid strategy, arrival mode, and spawn cell. Execution is owned by the caller.

li.name: factionDef
li.description: Optional hostile faction defName or faction name. Required when specifying strategy, arrival mode, or spawn cell.

li.name: raidStrategyDef
li.description: Optional RaidStrategyDef defName, for example ImmediateAttack, ImmediateAttackSmart, ImmediateAttackSappers, ImmediateAttackBreaching, or ImmediateAttackBreachingSmart.

li.name: raidArrivalModeDef
li.description: Optional PawnsArrivalModeDef defName, for example EdgeWalkIn, EdgeDrop, CenterDrop, RandomDrop, or SpecificDropDebug.

li.name: spawnCell
li.description: Optional map cell as x,z or x,y,z. Requires raidArrivalModeDef SpecificDropDebug; if omitted while spawnCell is set, SpecificDropDebug is assumed.

li.name: pointsFactor
li.description: Threat point multiplier for the raid. Defaults to 1.0.

li.name: reason
li.description: Short reason for the raid story beat.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Spawn pawns
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Validate spawning a number of default faction pawns near a specified map cell. Execution is owned by the caller.

li.name: factionDef
li.description: Faction defName or faction name, for example Pirate, OutlanderCivil, TribeRough, or Mechanoid.

li.name: count
li.description: Number of pawns to spawn. Range 1 to 50.

li.name: spawnCell
li.description: Target map cell as x,z or x,y,z.

li.name: radius
li.description: Optional placement radius around spawnCell. Range 0 to 30. Defaults to 5.

li.name: reason
li.description: Short reason for the pawn spawn request.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Web search
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Search the public web through Tavily for current external information. Do not use this for current RimWorld game-state data.

li.name: query
li.description: Search query.

li.name: maxResults
li.description: Maximum concise results to return. Range 1 to the configured Tavily cap. Defaults to the configured cap.

li.name: topic
li.description: Optional Tavily topic. Defaults to general.

li.name: timeRange
li.description: Optional recency filter: day, week, month, year, d, w, m, or y.

DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.label: Get RimTalk chat history
DeepseekTheOrca.OrcaToolDef.description: Read recent RimTalk ApiHistory records. Entries include origin, channel, state, speaker, recipient, messageText, requestText, and conversationId so Orca can distinguish player-written lines from automatic RimTalk dialogue.

li.name: count
li.description: Maximum number of recent RimTalk records to return. Range 1 to 30. Defaults to 10.

li.name: origin
li.description: Optional filter. Defaults to all.

li.name: channel
li.description: Optional RimTalk channel filter. Defaults to all. User is player-written chat, Stream is automatic dialogue, Query is usually ignored/query output.

li.name: state
li.description: Optional RimTalk ApiLog state filter. Defaults to all.

li.name: pawn
li.description: Optional case-insensitive speaker or recipient name filter.

li.name: conversationId
li.description: Optional exact RimTalk conversation id filter. Monologues may use -1.

li.name: maxChars
li.description: Maximum characters per prompt or response field. Range 80 to 2000. Defaults to 500.
